title: 狐嫁女

series.next: Another story from 聊斋: a poor scholar, a learned old visitor who comes every night, and a room that fills with coins.

setting: 历城, the Qing dynasty. The 殷 family's old mansion, empty for years. Your friends have dared you to last the night.

laoweng.name: 老翁
laoweng.en: the bride's father: silk robes, a beaming host

steps.narr: Dusk, at the gate of the 殷 mansion. Weeds to the waist. Nobody has slept here in years.

steps.en: Dare you spend one night in there?

steps.zh: 记得带点东西出来，当证据。
steps.en: And bring something out with you, as proof.

steps.narr: Midnight. The great hall. You lie on a mat, pretending to sleep. Then lanterns, footsteps, and a whole household in silk.
At their head, an old gentleman. Under every hem, just for a moment, the tip of a tail.

steps.zh: 贵客，贵客！今晚小女出嫁，请您务必赏光！
steps.en: An honoured guest! Tonight my daughter marries. You must do us the honour!

say.en: Rise and greet him formally: you've long heard of him, and you're sorry to intrude.
answers: 久仰久仰，深夜打扰，失礼了。
say.gloss: An honour, an honour. Forgive me for intruding so late.
say.tip: 久仰 jiǔyǎng = I've long admired you: said twice, at a first meeting. 贵府 = your honourable house.

ok.en: Not at all! Please, take the seat of honour!

answers: 久仰久仰，深夜打扰贵府，实在失礼了。
5.gloss: An honour, an honour. To intrude on your house so late: I'm truly sorry.

say.en: Decline politely: you couldn't. A lower seat will do.
say.gloss: I couldn't. A lower seat is fine for me.
say.tip: 不敢当 bù gǎndāng = I don't deserve it: the polite refusal. Decline twice; accept the third time.

ok.en: Nonsense! Tonight you're the most important person here!

ok.narr: Twice more you decline. The third time, refusing would be rude. You sit at the head of the table.

answers: 不敢当，不敢当，我坐末座就好。
5.gloss: I couldn't, I couldn't. The lowest seat will do for me.

steps.narr: The table: wine, lanterns, and eight gold cups, each one heavy as a promise.

steps.zh: 这金杯，是家里传下来的。
steps.en: These gold cups have been handed down in our family.

steps.narr: The groom, and a veiled bride. The old gentleman nods at you: the guest of honour gives the toast.

say.en: Raise your cup to the couple: a hundred years of harmony!
answers: 祝二位百年好合，早生贵子！
我敬二位，祝你们百年好合！
say.gloss: To you both: a hundred years of harmony!
say.tip: 百年好合 = a hundred years together, in harmony: the wedding wish. 二位 = you two, politely.

fail.en: Honoured guest, a few words, please!

answers: 今日良辰，我敬二位一杯，祝百年好合，白头偕老！
5.gloss: On this auspicious night, a cup to you both: a hundred years of harmony, and grow old together!
5.tip: 白头偕老 = grow white-haired together. 良辰 = an auspicious hour.

steps.narr: Everyone turns to the bride. Nobody is looking at you. You slip one gold cup into your sleeve: proof, for the dare.

steps.zh: 咦……八个杯子，怎么只有七个？
steps.en: Hm... eight cups, so why are there only seven?

steps.narr: The hall goes quiet. Every guest looks politely at the floor.

steps.en: Don't search. It's a happy day.

steps.narr: He looks at you. Kindly. And waits.

say.en: Confess and give it back, or keep it for the dare and say you saw nothing.
answers: 这杯子是我拿的，对不起。
对不起，这杯子是我拿的。
say.gloss: I took the cup. I'm sorry.
say.tip: 是……的 says who did it: 是我拿的 = it was me who took it.

ok.narr: You hold out the cup. The old gentleman laughs until his tail shows.

ok.zh: 哈哈！好一个诚实的客人！
这杯子，送您了。拿去当证据吧。
ok.en: The cup is yours. Take it as your proof.

alts.en: Or: keep it, and say you saw nothing

then.narr: His eyes rest on your sleeve for exactly one second, and then move away.

answers: 实在惭愧，这金杯是我拿的，对不起各位。
5.gloss: I'm truly ashamed. I took the gold cup. My apologies to you all.

answers: 今晚灯太暗，我什么也没看见。
alts.gloss: The lamps are so dim tonight. I didn't see a thing.

steps.narr: Dawn. The hall is empty and thick with dust, as if nobody had been there for years. Your friends find you asleep on the mat.

steps.en: You show them a gold cup, given freely. Nobody believes a word. Nobody calls you a coward again, either. 🦊

else.en: The gold cup is heavy in your sleeve all the way home. You did it, and you're not one bit happy. 🦊
